findings.claim: Three historical hypothesis revisions received the same unrelated Feynman/path-integral text, demonstrating that an LLM-produced revision can look structurally valid while being non-responsive to the hypothesis under evaluation.
findings.implication: Hypothesis transitions require explicit hypothesis identity, evidence refs, response-to-input consistency checks and rejection/quarantine when the evaluator output is not semantically tied to the tested proposition.
findings.next_test: Inject shuffled evaluator outputs between hypotheses and require the current research/hypothesis pipeline to detect and reject ancestry mismatch before state mutation.

findings.claim: A historical Energy recalibration fix existed correctly on disk while the running service still executed old code because it had not been restarted; 393 violations and six ineffective recalibrations continued. Source state and runtime state diverged materially.
findings.implication: A source-code diff or successful build is never a deployment receipt. H1/H2/H3 and final acceptance must bind process/runtime identity to exact build/config hashes and prove behavior after restart/reload.
findings.next_test: Mutate code without restarting a controlled service and verify the observability layer identifies runtime hash/version mismatch and refuses to call the fix deployed.

findings.claim: Adding two thought categories without rebuilding the historical PPO output layer produced a 100-vs-102 tensor mismatch and broke training; related prompt-index overflow appeared from the same schema drift.
findings.implication: Enumerations/action spaces/state schemas must carry versioned dimensional contracts and migration validation across model/runtime artifacts. Dynamic category growth cannot silently reuse incompatible learned heads.
findings.next_test: Change a typed action/category schema after training and require compile/load/startup validation to fail closed until a compatible migration or rebuilt artifact exists.

findings.claim: Historical audits found architecturally present subsystems that were effectively dead: Genesis stuck for 377,600 ticks with zero proposals, Dream Daemon ran once then stalled, Neural Immune looped on errors for days, and other state paths produced zero-byte outputs.
findings.implication: Module existence, service-up state and event emission are insufficient. Acceptance needs bounded-time liveness plus downstream causal-use/effect receipts for every behavior-defining subsystem.
findings.next_test: For each mandatory subsystem freeze a liveness contract: stimulus -> state transition/event -> consumer uptake -> observable effect within a bounded interval, with lesion and stuck-state controls.

findings.claim: The Ego Governor reportedly detected wrong model/architecture/hardware confabulations only after the response had already been sent, so detection did not causally prevent the user-visible error.
findings.implication: Safety/validation readouts must occur before the irreversible effect boundary or have a deterministic commit gate; post-effect detection is observability, not prevention.
findings.dedup: Corroborates existing external capability/commit gateway and safety-authority findings; no extra hours.

findings.claim: The v7 tool audit reported 10/32 correct tool executions (31%), about 30% format correctness, multiple hallucinated/wrong tools, and vision-triggered crash cascades despite the model often understanding when a tool was needed.
findings.implication: Semantic intent and executable form must be separated: deterministic canonicalization/validation should own executable IR, while model output remains an untrusted proposal.
findings.dedup: Format/tool-authority lessons already mapped by XENO/ClayCode and safety receipts; evidence strengthened without duplicate earned-work credit.

earned_work_candidate.mechanism_or_result: Historical high-information failure corpus supplies concrete regression oracles for hypothesis identity, deployment freshness, schema/model compatibility and subsystem liveness.
earned_work_candidate.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: Current harness must encode representative failures and demonstrate they fail historical-style fixtures and pass current implementation; otherwise avoided-work estimate is removed.

branch_feedback.frank: Treat runtime identity, hypothesis identity and subsystem liveness as architecture semantics, not operational afterthoughts.
branch_feedback.harness: Add deployment-freshness, shuffled-hypothesis-output, schema-drift and stuck-subsystem fixtures to H1/H2/H3 differential suites.
branch_feedback.claycode: Compile/load contracts must bind schema dimensions and executable IR; model text cannot be trusted merely because its tool intent is semantically plausible.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Persist schema/model/runtime epochs and evidence ancestry so stale learned artifacts and hypothesis results can be rejected transactionally.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Hypothesis/result edges require provenance and input-output ancestry; similarity alone cannot establish evaluator responsiveness.
branch_feedback.gwt: A workspace/subsystem that emits but produces no downstream uptake/effect is not functionally validated.
branch_feedback.emergenz: Liveness and causal-effect controls prevent counting decorative or dead components as integration/emergence evidence.
branch_feedback.clay: Preserve the historical audit corpus as executable negative fixtures rather than prose-only lessons.
